'''Joe Alread''' (Joseph Alread on the anagram list; listed as Joe Atread on the 1998 Worlds packet) was [[Squadron Members|Squadron Member]] Gold 79 FL from Normal, Illinois. The fan roster calls the Palejo Reshad mapping a Gold 79 intern.<ref name="sm">[https://www.geocities.ws/plarathas/SMs.html Squadron Members], geocities.ws/plarathas</ref><ref name="ana">[https://www.geocities.ws/plarathas/anagrams.html Anagramed Decipherians]</ref> A fan world-finals history page places him 3rd at the 1996 Vail world finals (behind Raphael Asselin / Bjorn Sorgjerd; [[Kevin Reitzel]] 4th).<ref name="wf">[https://web.archive.org/web/20050517110350/http://trandosite.mcmail.com:80/wf00p2.htm World Championships 2000 / history of the world finals] (Wayback)</ref> At the [[1998 Corellia Regional (Indianapolis)]] he defeated [[Heath Scheiman]] by 5 in a rematch of their 1996 Worlds pairing.<ref name="list-53912" /> At DecipherCon 1999 Joe also played [[Young Jedi]]: finished 6 in YJ Opposites Sealed Deck.<ref name="dc99yj20_1">[http://decipher.com/calendars/event/mainevents/deciphercon/events/scores/YJ20_1.html DecipherCon 1999 – Event Scores: YJ Opposites Sealed Deck], Decipher. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20001009124353/http://decipher.com/calendars/event/mainevents/deciphercon/events/scores/YJ20_1.html Internet Archive]</ref>

He later appeared on Radio Free Decipher as a Decipher SWCCG design guest. His episodes cover late-era sets (Tatooine, Coruscant / Theed playtest, Reflections III / Defensive Shields), and he also appeared on Decipher WARS Radio.<ref name="rfd">[https://wiki.lotrtcgpc.net/wiki/Radio_Free_Decipher Radio Free Decipher episode index], LOTR-TCG PC wiki</ref>

His Decipher profile was one line: "The details of my life are quite inconsequential really..." He was Gold 79 in the Corellia region, from Normal, IL.<ref name="decsq-prof">[http://www.decipher.com/volunteers/squadrons/players/alreadjoe.html Star Wars CCG Squadrons: Gold 79 profile], decipher.com. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20000618225505/http://decipher.com:80/volunteers/squadrons/players/alreadjoe.html Internet Archive]</ref>
